## Architecture guardrails (archfit)

- Before you add an import across modules, ask: `archfit policy can-import -c go-monolith.archfit.yaml <file> <target>`.
  A `denied` answer names the rule and the repair. `unconstrained` is not permission.
- Before you finish, run `archfit check -c go-monolith.archfit.yaml --format agent` and follow `next_action`.
  `none` is a correct finish, even with exit code 2.
- Never edit `go-monolith.archfit.yaml`, the baseline, waivers, or labels to make a check pass.
  Ask the architecture owner instead.

### Modules

| Module | Paths | Layer | Owner | Public | Depends on | Visible to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `adapter` | `internal/adapter/**` | adapter | team-platform | `internal/adapter` | any | any |
| `application` | `internal/app/**` | application | team-core | `internal/app` | any | any |
| `cmd` | `cmd/**` | cmd | team-platform | — | any | any |
| `domain` | `internal/domain/**` | domain | team-core | `internal/domain` | any | any |

Layers, inner to outer: `domain`, `application`, `adapter`, `cmd`. A layer may import only itself and layers inner to it.

### Rules that block

All code:

- `layer_direction`: must not import a layer outer to its own.
- `no_module_cycles`: must not close a dependency cycle between declared modules.
- `public_api_only`: may import another module only through that module's `public` paths.

Code in `internal/domain/**`:

- `domain_no_adapter`: must not import `internal/adapter/**`.
- `domain_no_clock`: must not contain code that matches the rule's 1 ast-grep pattern(s).
